title: Fruza Watermelon Bubble Blast 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: A fun and fruity confectionery blend, Fruza's Watermelon Bubble Blast is a must-try. This flavour combines the fresh, juicy taste of sweet Watermelon with a classic, sugary Bubblegum base. It's a playful and nostalgic vape that balances authentic fruit notes with a sweet finish. The Fruza Nic Salts range is crafted for vapers seeking clear,. intense, and authentic flavours. Inspired by Japanese precision and artistry, each 10ml e-liquid features a double concentration of flavour, designed to provide a rich and punchy taste experience. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It produces a discreet amount of vapour while carrying flavour exceptionally well. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit, even at higher nicotine levels, providing satisfying and rapid nicotine relief. Fruza Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, making them a versatile choice for a wide range of vapers. They are ideal for use in low-wattage pod vape kits and starter vape kits This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant, featuring a childproof cap and a tamper-evident seal for your safety. All Fruza e-liquid is made in the UK with high-quality ingredients for a premium and reliable vape.
